summary: Accept the bounded S0 native recovery feasibility matrix after independent evidence review; product phases remain open. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Native feasibility acceptance enables no operator workflow; Core API and UI delivery and their guide walkthroughs remain separate gates.

api.reason: This acceptance record changes no request, response, authorization or durable operation. It records the selected native boundary and clarifies the already-scoped NFS backup destination; API implementation remains in the relevant feature slices.

roadmap.reason: The internal feasibility gate is accepted, but Phase 5/6 availability and product milestone status remain unchanged.

state.reason: The record documents reviewed experiments and introduces no product state.

verification.method: Independent review checked the bounded native snapshot, paired firmware, chain, repository and backup results and their source/candidate provenance. The primary inspected the run5 receipt and full Go suite passed; Python discovery ran 548 tests with 547 passes and one Debian APT prerequisite skip. Focused later storage history tests passed separately. The preceding worktree documentation gate passed 178 paths; generated references and repository privacy checks passed. Acceptance excludes in-progress job-loss recovery, unresolved historical fixture uncertainty, product API/UI delivery and broader hardware certification. No remote CI success is claimed.
